latestTextRevision.evidence: The DEV rail note and header tagline were removed. Source syntax, JSON and local-asset checks pass. The recorded browser checks and PNGs were captured before these final text removals.

spacingRevision.evidence: The desktop shell and header are capped at 83.5rem, preserving a 46rem feed width and a measured 24px feed-to-rail gap at 1248, 1440 and 1920px. Nine responsive and enlarged-text layout checks passed with no browser errors. Refreshed desktop/mobile screenshots and independent UX review found no spacing regressions.

scope: Two local HTML UI mocks, existing features only. This is not a production readiness assessment.
evidence: verification.json records 60 layout/state checks, 65 interaction checks and zero browser errors after the DEV revisions. Refreshed desktop/mobile PNGs and an independent UX review confirm comfortable spacing. DEV checks verify Lucide topic icons, compact elapsed times, removed visible heading/month/snapshot/takeaway labels, and the 32px desktop header gap.

hardGate.evidence: Source scan found no em dashes in authored HTML or preview content.
No document overflow or clipped text at 320, 375, 414, 768, 1024 and 1440px; 200% text checked at 320, 768 and 1440px. Visible links and controls meet 44px targets.
Only the captured story displays HN counts, 608 points and 389 comments, with its 25 September snapshot provenance. Samples have no invented counts.
Neither mock contains testimonials or invented people.

The user explicitly requested two reference-based UI and design-system mocks. Existing text wordmark and local fonts are reused; sample stories are labeled; no person images or article artwork were generated.
Latest, all six topics, About and story links resolve to implemented local views. The Reddit month picker remains functional; the DEV month picker and its state were removed.
Computed visible text/background pairs pass AA in feed, detail, discussion, share and fallback states. Focus and control colors were inspected against their adjacent surfaces.

Recorded click-through covers topics, the Reddit month picker, story links, discussion, themes, sharing, related stories, Most read, About, continuation and preview controls. Shared action handlers were inspected for repeated controls.
Both mocks include ready, loading, empty and error views; error retry restores the feed. These are explicitly prototype simulations.
Keyboard checks cover visible focus, skip links, theme accordions, dialog Escape/focus return and mobile menu Escape. Native links, buttons, selects and dialogs are used.
UI source was authored directly with apply_patch. Verification scripts record evidence and do not rewrite UI source or CSS.
Only a light appearance is included, matching the existing product feature set; no theme toggle or unverified second theme exists.

Both HTML files ran via direct file URLs in Chromium. verification.json records the individual actions and state/layout results. Clipboard success used a stub; external targets were intercepted without network access.
No customer, compliance, security or performance claims are invented. Engagement outcomes are stated as hypotheses requiring measurement.
User-supplied Reddit/DEV references and explicit design-system direction informed both mocks; ENERGY 2 / RHYTHM 2 / MOTION 1 was declared before building.
One repository snapshot supplies authentic content; five stories are explicitly labeled samples. Most-read and related ordering are labeled layout samples with unavailable ranking data.

purposeGate.evidence: Rust and indigo identify selected navigation and reading/discussion actions in their respective reference-based systems. No gradients or glows are used.

Solid topic/action glyphs support compact scanning in A. User-requested Lucide boxes, code, flask, server, shield and building icons distinguish B's six labeled topics; decorative SVGs are aria-hidden. The icon rationale and licenses are recorded in dev.html.

Source Sans supports compact scanning in A; Bricolage supplies larger expressive headlines in B; Newsreader supports expanded reading in B. No decorative monospace headings or wide-tracked uppercase labels.
No background grid or decorative pattern exists.
Directional marks are limited to meaningful navigation and share/source glyphs, rather than decoration on every action.
Sample labels disclose provenance; selection states indicate current navigation. No promotional capsule badges or decorative status dots.
Shadow is limited to overlays such as share/preview panels, which sit above the page.
A lead story exposes the existing discussion summary, while later stories use a lighter treatment. Supporting Most read and related lists remain compact.
Motion is limited to interaction feedback and navigation; reduced motion is respected. There are no looping or decorative entrance animations.
No generic illustration or fabricated cover art is used. Text-only stories remain a deliberate supported state.

liveliness.evidence: Both directions explicitly declare ENERGY 2 / RHYTHM 2 / MOTION 1.
Lead stories, lighter subsequent items and supporting lists create deliberate variation; interaction-only motion matches the declared dial.
The lead story headline dominates each feed; the article title dominates each reader view.

A uses tight metadata/action groups and separators. B keeps a 32px desktop / 24px mobile header gap, 32px lead / 24px regular desktop top padding, 16px mobile padding and 16px card gaps. The desktop feed-to-rail gap is 24px, with reading width preserved. Screenshot review confirms the revised cards retain breathing room.
A uses rust and B uses indigo, concentrated on selection and reading/discussion actions.
Each direction repeatedly pairs the story brief with discussion analysis, using a consistent type and icon treatment across feed and reader.
The page kind, audience, visual directions and dials were declared before mock generation.

craftsmanshipAndQuality.evidence: Color, type, spacing, icons, surfaces and composition have one-line reasons in the comparison and source.
Existing-feature controls have local behavior; no proposed search, saves, voting or posting controls appear.
The composition uses feed, navigation, brief, discussion, Most read and related-story content. Duplicate promotional panels were removed.
Direct-file checks cover responsive and enlarged-text layouts, state views and keyboard interactions in Chromium. This is a mock-level check, not a cross-browser production certification.
Numbers and story provenance are authentic or explicitly marked as sample/unavailable.
Feed and reader composition follow current content needs, with distinct lead and secondary treatments rather than landing-page sections.
Control, card and grouped-action radii differ by function; every element is not pill-shaped.
Actions use specific labels such as Read brief, Discussion analysis, Share, Load more stories and Back to feed.
Source scan found no prohibited promotional buzzwords in authored UI copy.
The brief-plus-discussion composition and distinct visual systems give the product a specific news-reading identity.
The existing product specifies a light reading appearance. The mocks keep that choice and do not add a new appearance feature.
Each direction uses one principal accent plus neutral surfaces and text colors.
Reddit and DEV are explicitly authorized references; their social/account features and dense promotional modules are omitted, while Hacksnap’s briefs and discussion analysis shape the composition.
Written rationale covers color, layout, typography, spacing, cards and icons for both directions in index.html and source comments.
